Dashboard not built

This binary was built without the SvelteKit dashboard bundle. To produce a working dashboard, run the build script then rebuild the Go binary:

./scripts/build-web.sh    # or .\scripts\build-web.ps1 on Windows
go build ./cmd/server

This file is a committed placeholder so that //go:embed all:dist resolves on a fresh checkout — the build script overwrites it with the real bundle.
